#   3. Write your writeup in the body, below the second "---".

  - STM32
  - KiCad

## Context

What problem were you solving, and why does it matter? One or two paragraphs.
Set the scene for someone who has never heard of this project.

## My Role

Be specific about what *you* did, especially on team projects. Recruiters read
this closely — distinguish your contribution from the group's.

## Approach

The technical meat. Architecture decisions, the hard parts, tradeoffs. Drop in
images, schematics, or code where they help:

```c
// short, illustrative code snippets are great here — keep them tight
```

## Outcome

What happened? Results, measurements, what you would do differently, what you
learned. Numbers land well: "closed-loop control at 1 kHz", "cut boot time 40%".
